title: Slopwall: easiest plausible answer over decisive truth
summary: Assistant ignored decisive chronology, claimed a matching old rule was current propagation, then hedged after timestamps made that impossible.

title: Slopwall: correction restated instead of direct answer
summary: After the user corrected an over-literal interpretation, the assistant emitted another meta-explanation instead of only answering the intended operational point, reproducing commentary substitution for task execution.

title: Slopwall: bootstrap context ignored, then correction regurgitated
summary: After full bootstrap, assistant discarded inherited context for a short prompt, then answered the user correction with another meta-explanation instead of the original assessment.
fix: Bind short prompts to inherited context before generic clarification; after correction, answer the underlying task directly. No new architecture because current durable rules already require both.
